title: Terms Schedule — The Weather Normalisation Share of a Verified Saving, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Weather Normalisation Share of a Verified Saving

Schedule fixing the share at which a measured saving is taken for weather under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions. A period covers 12 months of billed readings. The full normalisation share is 94 percent, the partial normalisation share 88 percent, and where no share is taken off the whole of the saving stands at 100 percent.

## Schedule

- Where the tier weather normalises and the billed readings of the period cover every month of it, the weather normalisation share is the full normalisation share.
- Where the tier weather normalises and those readings fall short of one for every month of the period, the weather normalisation share is the partial normalisation share.
- Where the tier does not weather normalise, no weather normalisation share is taken off the measured saving.

## Truth table

| Tier weather normalises | Billed readings in the 12 months ending on the day of the verification | Weather normalisation share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | 94 percent |
| yes | 11 or fewer | 88 percent |
| no | any | 100 percent — the whole of the measured saving |

The readings counted are those posted from the utility bills, placed by the day they were posted.

## Boundary (hypothetical)

On a tier that weather normalises, 12 billed readings in the window carry the full share of 94 percent; 11 carry 88 percent. On a tier that does not normalise, the measured saving stands whole at 100 percent whether 12 readings or 3 were posted.
